gen-gf-turret-road-gf-fahkwang: Turret Road stamps out round, parenthesis-like forms in a pen line that never changes weight, like laser-cut sheet metal. Fahkwang below has a faint felt-marker swell and curves that stop short of closing.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-figtree: Commanding round letters up top, drawn in one pen-like line, meet Figtree's marker-tip shapes and its wide-mouthed e below. Turret Road announces, and Figtree quietly carries the talking.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-finlandica: Turret Road leads with round forms like open parentheses, all drawn in a single pen-like line. And Finlandica follows that same constancy, with an outline you could trace with a finger and crossbars that stay open.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-fustat: Fustat reads like bent rope or tubing, with a wide gap where each c finishes its curve. And Turret Road overhead, bold and pen-lined, gives that softness a firm, round-shouldered headline to lean on.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-gantari: Gantari looks wire-bent from end to end, with wide apertures that keep each word easy to enter. Gantari's approachable shapes sit under Turret Road's bold parenthesis curves and carry a longer page without strain.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-gayathri: Gayathri has open-ended curves and the mild thick-thin shift of a letterpress slug, tempered enough to avoid jolting or flattening. But Turret Road is the one for hairline-free, shadow-free boldness, while Gayathri does the gentle work of the text.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-google-sans: Round, parenthesis-like forms in one pen-like line give Turret Road its commanding look. And Google Sans follows with no thick-thin shift and terminals pulled well back, so a long page moves along smoothly.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-google-sans-flex: Bold, round and pen-drawn, Turret Road looks like it was made to be noticed. Google Sans Flex has stroke ends cut from one ribbon and clean open curves, so a long page reads without friction.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-gothic-a1: Approachable is the first word for Gothic A1, with its splayed c terminal and low hairline-to-stem shift, against Turret Road's bold, commanding rounds. Their strongest trait is how smoothly that gentle text meets such a confident heading.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-gotu: Big, round and commanding, Turret Road has no pinched joints or flared ends anywhere. And Gotu feels modern beside it, with sturdy hairlines and only a modest gap in weight between stems and thin strokes.
